seo.title: Book 6 Days Majestic Meghalaya Tour - Kajaawa
seo.description: This 6 Day Majestic Meghalaya Tour is offered by Kajaawa at a very affordable price with quality accommodation and transportation.

content.text: In this majestic Meghalaya tour, you will be having lots of fun-filled moments and sightseeing in the stunning locations of Meghalaya. Visit the very famous man-made Umiam Lake which you will encounter en route to Shillong. You will also visit the prominent sites of Shillong city. Sightseeing the beautiful waterfalls and caves in Cherrapunji will make your tour even better. Trek to see the majestic looking Double Decker Bridge in Cherrapunji and visit the cleanest village in Asia. You will also be visiting the Umngot River in Dawki where you can enjoy boating. At the end of this tour, you will be visiting the Mawphlang village to see the sacred groves and various flora species.

main.title: Tour Highlights
items: Sightseeing of the stunning Umiam Lake which is en route to Shillong
Explore Shillong and visit Lady Hydari Park, Shillong Golf Course and many more
Witness the beautiful sites and waterfalls of Cherrapunji
Trek to the Living Root Bridge in Cherrapunji which is almost 5 hours trek
Visit the cleanest village in Asia which is situated in Mawlynnong
Head to Dawki and enjoy boating on the transparent Umngot River
Spend a day visiting the Mawphlang Sacred Groves and its various floral species

days.title: Day 1 : Guwahati to Shillong
items: Get picked up from Guwahati Airport to start your majestic trip to Meghalaya.
En route to Shillong stop at Umiam Lake and enjoy admiring its beautiful view.
In Shillong, you will be visiting the famous Lady Hydari Park, Ward’s Lake and Shillong Golf Course.
Later in the evening check in at your hotel in Shillong.

days.title: Day 2 : Sightseeing In Cherrapunji
items: Have your delicious breakfast at the hotel in the morning.
Cherapunji's magnificent journey will take you through Meghalaya's hills and valleys.
On this excursion, see the Nohkalikai Falls, Seven Sisters Falls, Mawsmai Caves, Arwah Caves, Dainthlen Falls and the spectacular Wei Sawdong Falls.
Check into the hotel/homestay in Cherrapunji in the evening.

days.title: Day 3 : Double Decker Trek
items: This morning, have a nice breakfast before setting off on the 3-hour walk to Double Decker Bridge.
You will walk through the beautiful greenery and encounter many species of flora.
Visit the local village, markets, and stores in Cherrapunji after the walk.
Spend your free time doing anything you choose.

days.title: Day 4 : Dawki and Mawlynnong Trip
items: Get out of bed and have your yummy breakfast.
Travel to Dawki in the afternoon. a small town with beautiful scenery and the pure waters of the Umngot River.
Do boating at the Dawki River, explore its surroundings and visit the Indo-Bangladesh Border.
Thereafter, go to Mawlynnong Village, which is recognised as the cleanest village in Asia.
Tour the entire village and witness its cleanliness and the village life.
Also visit the amazing Borhill Falls.
Later check in your hotel/homestay in Mawlynnong.

days.title: Day 5 : Mawphlang-Shillong
items: Get up early, have breakfast, and get ready for your journey.
Visit the Sacred Grove in Mawphlang, an ideal location for environment enthusiasts who appreciate flora and animals.
Drive to Elephant Falls before continuing on to Shillong Peak for a panoramic view of the city.
Check in to your accommodation in Shillong.

days.title: Day 6 : Departure
items: After breakfast, you will check out of your hotel and go to Guwahati Airport/Railway station.
Finish the six-day tour and go on your way, putting the adventure to a close.

items.text: Travellers visiting Meghalaya are required to register on Meghalaya Tourism App and generate an e-invite.
You can download the Meghalaya Tourism App from Google Play Store or App Store.
No reimbursement will be made against missed services.
Travellers are required to show their valid identity cards at the time of check-in to the hotel.
You should not consume alcohol or other intoxicants during your tour.
The vehicle allotted for the tour will be available as per the itinerary and not for general disposal.
In the Northeast, generally, vehicles like Sedan do not have carriers. You are advised to carry one bag per person. Kindly give us prior information in case you have more luggage.

Delay in arrival due to many reasons including flight reschedules shall have to inform to us at an earliest and in case of any sightseeing spot missed due to any delay including spending more time in one sightseeing spot, will not be refundable.

Kajaawa will provide accommodation as per the hotels in the list and in case the listed hotels cannot be provided for any reason like unavailability, scheduled or general maintenance, accident at the hotel, risky road conditions due to bad weather or political disturbance, similar hotels will be provided and you will be informed about the changes in advance.

In Deluxe and Premium Tour Packages, we will generally arrange Deluxe and Premium Hotels but in interior places, we will arrange Homestays, Guest Houses or Standard Hotels as Deluxe and Premium accommodations may not be available in the interiors for any reason.
In case of any unforeseen situations which are beyond our control including bad weather conditions, political disturbance etc., we may change your itinerary or dates of travel.
Travellers may have to bear additional expenses in case of natural calamity including situations like changes in the hotel, changes in tour date etc.
You have to pay 50% of the total tour cost at the time of booking.
After paying 50% you will receive an invoice of your payment and also booking confirmation details containing your detailed travel itinerary and hotel information.
25% of the total cost, if the tour is cancelled 30 days before the tour starts.
50% of the total cost, if the tour is cancelled 15-30 days before the tour starts.
100% of the total cost, if the tour is cancelled 0-15 days before the tour starts.
100% of the tour cost has to be paid 1 (one) week before the tour starts.
Refunds will be processed within 7(seven) business days in the customer’s bank account.
